tests.test: WIL-04 make public lets a stranger past the ward, private locks again

asserts.check: a player-built chest in the ward can be managed: do=hook, name=lock.isEligible, args={target=chest}, expect=true, label=a player-built chest in the ward can be managed
Alice makes it public: do=hook, name=lock.setPublic, args={target=chest, on=true}, expect=true, label=Alice makes it public
Bob opens the public chest (WardIsLove must not block it): uiVisible: do=check, name=InventoryGui, expect=true, label=Bob opens the public chest (WardIsLove must not block it)
Alice makes it private again: do=hook, name=lock.setPublic, args={target=chest, on=false}, expect=false, label=Alice makes it private again
Bob is locked out again: uiVisible: do=check, name=InventoryGui, expect=false, label=Bob is locked out again
noErrors: source=LockSmith
asserts.detail: no errors since the test started
